title: Stock Price Fluctuation
goal: Maintain corrected stock prices and answer current, minimum, and maximum queries.
strategy: Store the latest price per timestamp, overwriting corrections. Current means the greatest timestamp, while extrema must be computed from all corrected values rather than historical updates.
